```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns'
        required: false
        default: '50'

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install Claude Code CLI
        run: npm install -g claude-code

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          # The CLI writes generated docs to ./generated-docs
          claude-code --max-turns ${{ inputs.max_turns }}

      - name: Clone docs-new repository
        run: |
          git clone https://x-access-token:${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}@github.com/algolia/docs-new.git docs-new

      - name: Copy generated docs to docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cp -r ./generated-docs/* docs-new/

      - name: Commit changes to docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          if git diff-index --quiet HEAD; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "docs: update for InstantSearch release ${{ github.sha }}"
          fi

      - name: Push changes to docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        run: |
          cd docs-new
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/docs-automation-${{ github.sha }}

      - name: Set up GitHub CLI
        if: ${{ inputs.create_pr == 'true' && inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        uses: cli/cli@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}

      - name: Create PR in docs-new
        if: ${{ inputs.create_pr == 'true' && inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
        run: |
          gh pr create --repo algolia/docs-new \
            --title "docs: update for InstantSearch release ${{ github.sha }}" \
            --body "Automated docs update for release ${{ github.sha }}." \
            --draft \
            --reviewer frontend-experiences-web \
            --head docs-automation-${{ github.sha }} \
            --base main

      - name: Dry run
        if: ${{ inputs.run_claude == 'false' }}
        run: |
          echo "Dry run: no changes will be made."
```
